items.q: Our site is not in a named centre. Are we covered?
items.a: The row for your province applies. Send the site address and we state the on-site response time, the stocking point and the technician's base in writing before you sign. Outside [service coverage area] we agree a travel response in the plan schedule and recommend a critical spares kit on your site. [partners for remote regions: confirm]

items.q: Who is the technician: your employee or a subcontractor?
items.a: [Aquemi employees or partners, and who signs reports]

items.q: Do you service systems another builder supplied?
items.a: Yes, for [makes and equipment types serviced]. The service request form takes the make and model; you do not need an Aquemi serial number.

items.q: Will our system get a CRN in our province?
items.a: Under CSA B51, pressure-retaining stills, pure steam generators and pressure-rated tanks need a CRN from the authority in the province of installation, and a design registered in one province is registered again for another. Registration sits in the project schedule from the start. [Aquemi CRN process and provinces covered]

items.q: Can the design be sealed by an engineer licensed in our province?
items.a: Drawings and calculations for your site are sealed by an engineer licensed where the site is: P.Eng., or ing. in Quebec. [provinces where Aquemi engineers are licensed] Where we are not licensed: [engineer of record route, if used].
[French service: people, reports and documents]. For a system installed in Quebec, ask your legal team which documents the Charter of the French language requires in French.

items.q: How does the skid get from FAT to our dock?
items.a: After the FAT is signed and released: [drain and drying method after wet FAT], open ends capped and sealed, [crating standard and shock indicators], by road from the shop in [transit time to main centres, days]. Skid condition and seals are checked on arrival against the shipping record, before installation and the SAT.
